availability.name: Service availability
availability.source: logs/last-availability.json — 30-day window from the edge access log
availability.remediation: Check the deploy history and the incident log; runbook at docs/RUNBOOK.md

errorRate.name: API error rate
errorRate.remediation: Check /api/health failures; roll back if the rate holds for 15 minutes

latencyP95.name: API p95 latency
latencyP95.remediation: Profile the slow endpoints; add caching or scale the instances

testPassRate.name: Test suite pass rate
testPassRate.remediation: A red test must block the merge; fix it before the next deploy

buildSuccessRate.name: Build success rate
buildSuccessRate.source: build-reports/web-build.json — the outcome of the last build, not a rate
buildSuccessRate.remediation: A failed build blocks the deploy; read the CI log

deploySuccessRate.name: Deploy success rate
deploySuccessRate.source: logs/last-deploy.json — written by the deploy step after it finishes
deploySuccessRate.remediation: A failed deploy must be rolled back within 15 minutes

escapeRate.name: Escaped defect rate
escapeRate.remediation: Every escaped defect gets a root cause; see docs/CMMI-L5-ROADMAP.md
